name: VectorCraft v0.13.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix #866: macOS save sheets have a Format menu again by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2379
* i18n: add Dutch, Danish, Hindi and Indonesian interfaces by @pechnikov2026-star in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2393
* Cursors: 36 more tool states get cursors of their own, listed in cursors.toml by @bobtherobot in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2334
* Part of #394: Highlight Alternate Glyphs paints pink behind OpenType substitutions by @Messhias in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1365
* Layers: a .ai another app wrote opens with its top-level layers closed, as its groups by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1510
* Render: check an image's RGBA size before decoding it by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2442
* Render: an export no longer warns about images another thread could not decode by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2604
* Images: sampling and recoloring check an image's RGBA size without overflowing by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2468
* Crop Image: trim checks the image's RGBA size before decoding it by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2407
* PDF export: Add Around is clamped when a file opens, and art too large for f64 gets no effect image by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2440
* Fix graph axis labels saturating beyond the i64 range by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2610
* Reject '+' and other non-hex characters in Color::from_hex by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2470
* Escape XML ID first characters that cannot start an XML name by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2447
* Lint: action_batch.rs compiles without an unused import on wasm32 by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2463
* Tests: CLI tests do not fail on folders an earlier run left behind by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2605
* Tests: a language one ui-egui test sets no longer translates the tests running beside it by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2570
* Wayland: pointer returns over panels and menus after a tool cursor (#2450) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2502
* PNG export: an sRGB chunk marks the colours as sRGB (#2221) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2519
* Character: the Kerning field at a caret kerns the pair, not the whole text (#2217) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2518
* Type: selected overflowing type shows its red out port with any tool (#2323) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2517
* Color: Generic CMYK black round-trips through hex (#2493) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2503
* Overprint Preview: a colour overprinting itself stays that colour (#2415) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2514
* Layers: Merge Selected with a layer and its sublayer highlighted merges into the last top-level layer (#2383) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2498
* Panels: floating panel groups paint an opaque background (#2421) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2499
* Gradient chips: follow the angle and the gradient type (#2494) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2495
* Export: raster document.export takes a page rectangle (#2412) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2511
* Fix #2540: Object → Expand expands Intertwine groups by @odgrim in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2622
* Part of #2384: imported PDF text keeps its place after wide gaps between words by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2620
* Libraries: a plain click sets where a Shift-click range starts by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2618
* Graphic Styles: Shift-click selects a range of styles by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2612
* Links: Shift-click selects a range of links by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2613
* View: in Presentation Mode no key but ←, → and Escape acts, and no context menu opens by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2583
* Rotate View: a Space+Shift drag rotates the view from any tool by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2601
* Appearance: the inline effect editor's text fields keep what is typed by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2599
* Document Raster Effects Settings: a file's resolution outside 1 to 2400 ppi opens in range by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2579
* Quote graph data CSV labels so they round-trip through graph.setData by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2568
* Artboards: commands given an index that names no artboard fail instead of editing another one by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2566
* docs: quick Image Trace presets trace at once; the Image Trace button opens the controls (#2585) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2640
* Effects: skip type tests when built without craft-fonts (#2476) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2477
* Effects: a Transform effect on a group paints each copy with its own gradient (#2451) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2486
* Effects: Zig Zag Smooth points draw a continuous wave (#2343) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2475
* Type: text.create and text.createInPath return the new type's bounds (#2413) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2478
* Type: a tab takes its width when area type breaks and justifies its lines (#2457) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2487
* Dimension tool: Shift preview, snap indicator, clicks snap onto lines and anchors (#2432, #2516) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2482
* Render: Inner Glow on a pattern fill draws along the edges, not at the top left (#2426) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2510
* Fix native font labels when only legacy names are localized by @EuanTop in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2237
* Live Corners: a corner rounds until its cut reaches its neighbours (#2332) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2484
* Fix Illustrator EPS import to preserve editable vector artwork by @theromis in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2571
* MCP: scope doc_inspect by ids, kind and page (#2167) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2543
* PDF export: report RGB colours and images in a CMYK document (#2162) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2522
* MCP: cancel long exports, answer while one runs, report progress (#2165, #2171) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2546
* Persistence: saved PDF presets and loaded ICC profiles survive a restart (#2168, #2174) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2547
* Accessibility: buttons, toggles, checkboxes and sliders have names for screen readers by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2611
* Swatches: Alt-click on a swatch recolors the selected gradient stop by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2623
* Print: Print, Print Preview and Print Setup take a print preset by name by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2607
* Variables: Import Data Sets… reads tab-separated files and files without a name column by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2608
* Type: a click in a Devanagari syllable goes to its nearer end, and shaping is tested by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2602
* TIFF: planar grayscale files with extra channels, and planar CMYK files, open and place by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2598
* Docs: type-parity and the roadmap list the Hyphenation options as done by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2580
* i18n: Simplified Chinese translates status-bar and error messages by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2578
* SVG export: justified and Mojikumi lines keep their letter spacing in live text by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2574
* Type: a change of paint, baseline shift or rotation on one character keeps the font's kerning by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2554
* .ai import: a Drop Shadow with Darkness comes in with its Darkness by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2513
* Character: Small Caps, Superscript and Subscript buttons and menu items set the text by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2508
* Actions: Batch keeps files named after data sets inside the destination folder by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2504
* Type: redefining a text style back to a default updates the text that uses it by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2501
* Render: every raster export warns about an undecodable image inside a pattern by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2621
* Effects: effect.apply and effect.setParams refuse a color the effect can't draw by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2617
* Templates: Save as Template always writes a file with a template extension by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2597
* i18n: file filters, preset names and mark styles are translated in every complete language by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2590
* Artboards: Duplicate Artboards, Copy and Cut take every selected artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2567
* Images: sampling and recoloring decode images past 512 MB, up to 2 GB by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2507
* Transform panel: the menu's Flip Horizontal and Flip Vertical keep the reference point by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2400
* Transform: a percentage typed alone in W or H scales the size it shows by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2404
* i18n and docs: rows and ROADMAP entry for the community PRs landed on 2026-10-17 by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2649
* View: Show Transparency Grid is saved with the document by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2488
* Layers: the panel menu's Save Selection submenu saves, lists and updates saved selections by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2483
* Character: Reset Panel resets every attribute the panel shows except the font and size by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2479
* Guides: a Cmd/Ctrl+Shift double-click releases the guide under the pointer by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2467
* Type: emptying the text while editing keeps its character style by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2464
* File formats: PostScript (.ps) and .epsf files open and place by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2461
* Missing Fonts: a folder the search refuses says why in the dialog, not "Not found" by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2458
* Gradient mesh: an opaque patch is backed by its outline, so patches that narrow to slivers leave no holes by @EricKuck in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2456
* Recolor Artwork: dragging a wheel handle of CMYK art keeps the linked handles in place by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2454
* PDF export: a CMYK image's own soft mask is written as its /SMask, not a luminosity mask by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2448
* EPS: images encoded with CCITTFaxDecode draw by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2445
* AI import: a compound path whose subpaths' group is marked like a look keeps its holes by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2444
* Effects: Smart Blur's Radius widens the edge search in Edge Only and Overlay Edge by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2443
* Paragraph: Reset Panel also resets the Hyphenation options by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2438
* EPS import: an Illustrator 3 file without layers opens its paths on one layer (fixes storytold/photocraft#6036) by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2436
* Fields: Shift+Enter applies a panel field's value and keeps the field active by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2431
* Paths: Shift keeps a reshaped segment's handles perpendicular and equal in length by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2425
* .ai import: type keeps its own opacity and blend mode by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2420
* #2405: an envelope's mesh in an .ai isn't read as art by @jmverges in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2410
* Color effects recolour the points of a freeform gradient by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2397
* Image Trace: six fixes from @andeecollard (#2589, #2584, #2387, #2586, #2587, #2588) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2658
* i18n: blend spine errors are translated in every complete language by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2624
* Blend: Window › Blend opens a Blend panel with the blend's spacing, orientation and commands by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2573
* Brushes: Shift-click and Ctrl/Cmd-click select several brushes, and Delete Brush deletes them by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2562
* Place: RTF files place as area type with their formatting by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2524
* Type: the Touch Type tool moves, scales and rotates single characters by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2469
* PDF: colours are written in the profiles assigned to the document by @japbcoelho in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2536
* Save and Export ask before replacing a file that an added extension names by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2619
* Expand: pattern fills expand into their tiles clipped by the shape by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2616
* Type: Optical Margin Alignment hangs punctuation and letter edges outside the frame by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2563
* Control bar: the Artboard tool shows the active artboard's preset, name, X, Y, W and H by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2559
* Contextual Task Bar: the Artboard tool offers Resize, Duplicate, Rearrange All and Export by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2556
* Artboards: Alt-click on New Artboard opens Artboard Options for the new artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2496
* Window: the SVG Interactivity panel attaches JavaScript events and files for SVG export by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2437
* Live Paint: Gap Options find and close gaps in Live Paint groups by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2424
* Graphs: Object › Graph › Column draws columns with graph designs by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2406
* Move dialog opens remembers the last drag or move values by @danngreen in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2542
* Print: open printing preferences for the selected printer on Windows … by @dennismutuku2005 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2577
* i18n and docs: rows and ROADMAP entry for the fifth 2026-10-17 batch by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2666
* i18n(fi): review the machine-drafted Finnish rows by @Janiz-zzz in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2472
* G2: Effect › Artistic › Cutout, Neon Glow and Poster Edges by @VL420 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2453
* Rotate View: resize and rotate cursors turn with the view by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2594
* Appearance: the inline effect editor shows choice parameters as dropdowns with the dialog's labels by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2582
* G7: View › Rulers › Change to Global / Artboard Rulers by @VL420 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2416
* Symbols: Symbol Options › Enable Guides for 9-Slice Scaling (#2342) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2512
* Gradient mesh: Create Gradient Mesh on an embedded image (#1676) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2538
* .ai import: type from the layers opens without the PDF part's outlines warnings by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2667
* Fix #2276: the Eyedropper and RGB input give color-managed CMYK values in a process document by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2664
* Object Mosaic: columns and rows that are not whole numbers are refused by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2659
* Escape quotes and backslashes in exported CSS font-family by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2657
* New Document and Document Setup: values out of range in a saved preset or a file are read in range by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2656
* Part of #2422: a selected clip group shows its clipping path's outline, not its hidden art by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2650
* Rasterize, Flatten Transparency: commands that replace art with a rendering warn about an undecodable image by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2648
* Images: the too-large note counts the image's pixels as RGBA by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2647
* Type: a huge selection of type on a path draws no per-object brackets by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2645
* Rotate View: a two-finger rotation on a Mac trackpad turns the view about the pointer by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2644
* Variables: a data set rewrites bound type on hidden layers by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2641
* Blends, meshes and envelopes: an index or count that is not a whole number is refused by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2638
* Artboards: Rearrange and Select All on Active Artboard measure a symbol instance by its art by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2614
* Artboards: art centered on an artboard's right or bottom edge is on that artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2637
* Print: a Print Tiling origin on an artboard's right or bottom edge is measured from that artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2665
* Part of #2460: a huge selection of type, images, symbols or meshes shows its bounds by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2635
* Save: save panels for files other than documents offer the file type they write by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2633
* Layers panel: drop a layer under the last row to move it to the bottom (#2260) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2632
* Variables: Lock Variables stops variables from being defined, deleted or renamed by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2631
* Part of #2345: a marquee does not select a clip group by its hidden art by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2630
* Guides: Lock Guides keeps guides deselected after Undo, Exit Isolation Mode and Paste by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2629
* Export: PDF, EPS, SVG, EMF, WMF and image exports warn about type that doesn't fit its frame by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2628
* Artboards: Shift-click in the Artboards panel selects a range of artboards by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2626
* Background save: dropped Puppet Warp pins, ended Edit Text and font scans leave the document saved by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2625
* Part of #2441: Group Selection picks and moves one path of a compound path; i18n and docs for the sixth batch by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2686
* i18n: the History panel translates the undo step names the sources write as literals by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2609
* Fix #2541: installed plug-ins stay installed after a restart by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2695
* Part of #2572: clicking an area type's out port threads its text into a path or a new frame by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2713
* Fix #2603: a panel per swatch library, with Persistent by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2714
* Create Strokes: skeleton graph with junction merging by @andeecollard in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2705
* Image Trace: Raster::new returns an error for a buffer of the wrong length by @andeecollard in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2701
* Image Trace: large images trace with a warning; anchor limit 8,000,000 by @andeecollard in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2700
* Image Trace: Auto Color keeps rare but distinct colours by @andeecollard in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2702
* Character: variable fonts get a slider for each axis by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2710
* Paths: Reshape Segment, Convert Anchor Point and the Pencil refuse values of 1e9 pt or more by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2709
* Contextual Task Bar: direct-selected anchors offer Connect, Corner and Smooth by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2697
* Import PDF 0 w strokes as hairlines instead of dropping them by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2696
* Effects: Effect › Rasterize draws an object as pixels while its paths stay editable by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2409
* i18n and docs: Image Trace warnings in every complete language; ROADMAP for the evening's landings by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2724
* G4: Paragraph panel menu › Roman Hanging Punctuation by @VL420 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2775
* Fix #1876: Artboard Options has X and Y with a reference point by @guillehr2 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2739
* Fonts: a variable font's default face is named and weighed by its default instance (#2521) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2733
* Fonts: fallback glyphs keep bold/italic, Bold Italic of a missing family keeps the bold, CJK prefers an installed sans (#2491) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2732
* i18n(nl): complete the Dutch catalog by @nvict-service in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2730
* Write legacy .ai layer names in Windows Latin-1 and warn when a character is replaced (#2693) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2722
* Map the WMF window onto the placeable box (#2673) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2721
* Magic Wand: only select objects inside the isolated group (#2655) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2720
* Blend: edit spine points and handles with the Anchor Point tool (#2544) by @makesomethingshit in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2643
* Shadows and glows: each is of the art with the ones before it in the stack, and an Outer Glow blurs a solid silhouette by @EricKuck in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2395
* 3D effects: one to ten coloured lights (#2706) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2787
* G1: Contextual Task Bar: Join, Edit Path, Release and type conversion by selection by @VL420 in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2471
* Type: superscript, subscript and small caps proportions out of range in a file are read in range by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2728
* Type: sizes, scales, leading, indents and spacing out of range in a file are read in range by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2757
* Type: Optical Margin Alignment is a setting of the whole thread by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2773
* Shaper: a marquee does not select a Shaper Group by the original shape of an erased face by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2772
* TIFF: CCITT Group 3 compressed files open and place by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2770
* Place: Word .docx files place as area type with their formatting by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2766
* PDF presets: a rename that can't be written keeps the preset under its old name by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2767
* History: the panel menu has Step Backward, Step Forward and Set History Limit… by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2764
* Artboards: Ctrl/Cmd+A in the Artboards panel selects every artboard with the Artboard tool by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2761
* .ai import: the warning that the layers differ from the page gives the art's share or names the type by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/2760
